findings.title: split_csv path traversal via unsanitized group_column → arbitrary file write
findings.description: ConstructionCSVHandler.split_csv builds output paths as Path(output_dir) / f"{group_column}_{value}.csv" with no sanitization. When group_column is an absolute path, pathlib replaces the base directory and writes outside output_dir. When group_column begins with '../', the join resolves above output_dir. Attacker-controlled CSV column names (or agent-selected headers from untrusted exports) become write targets.
findings.impact: Arbitrary file write as the process user: overwrite configs, drop payloads under writable paths, or plant files outside the intended split directory. Same class as prior bim-cost project_name path write, but with a stronger absolute-path Path-join replacement vector.
attack_path: 1. Supply an untrusted CSV whose header (or instruct the agent to use a column named) '/tmp/evil' or '../escaped'.
2. Agent/operator calls split_csv(df, group_column=<attacker header>, output_dir='./split_files').
3. filename becomes '/tmp/evil_<value>.csv' (absolute) or '../escaped_<value>.csv'; Path(output_dir)/filename escapes the sandbox.
4. subset.to_csv(filepath) writes attacker-controlled CSV content to the escaped path.
findings.remediation: Reject group_column/value containing path separators or '..'. Basename-only sanitize both components. Resolve the final path and assert it remains under output_dir.resolve() before writing.

findings.title: add_assignment accepts negative units that cancel usage and hide overallocation
findings.description: add_assignment stores ResourceAssignment.units with no positivity check. calculate_resource_usage does usage[resource_id][i] += assignment.units, so a second assignment with units=-N cancels a legitimate +N load. identify_overallocations then compares daily_usage > max_units and returns empty, so level_resources reports success with no moves.
findings.impact: Safety/schedule fraud: hide crane/crew overallocation that should block work or force leveling. Distinct methods from Insights crane negative-units finding (add_assignment / calculate_resource_usage / identify_overallocations in book resource-leveler).
attack_path: 1. Legitimate schedule assigns crane units=2 while max_units=1 (true overallocation).
2. Attacker calls add_assignment with the same resource/dates and units=-2 (or any canceling negative).
4. identify_overallocations returns []; leveling/success dashboards treat the schedule as resource-safe.
findings.remediation: Reject assignment.units <= 0 in add_assignment. Optionally clamp or abs() in calculate_resource_usage. Fail closed if net usage is negative.

findings.title: set_payment_terms negative retainage_rate understates financing_required despite lifetime cancel
findings.description: Prior near-miss: negative retainage_rate inflates monthly net_billing but the final Retainage Release uses contract_value * retainage_rate (also negative), so lifetime income still equals contract_value. Re-evaluation shows the skill's primary decision outputs—peak_deficit and financing_required—are still forged for the entire construction period. PoC on a $5M/12mo project: financing_required drops from $360k (rate=0.10) to $147k (rate=-0.10) while lifetime income stays $5M.
findings.impact: Line-of-credit / financing decisions based on generate_forecast / calculate_financing_cost undersize liquidity needs by hundreds of thousands. Distinct from toolkit permanent inflow inflate and from pay-app neg retainage overbill: methods are set_payment_terms + generate_billing_schedule; impact is financing understatement, not payment overbilling.
attack_path: 1. Initialize CashFlowForecaster for a financed project (contract_value, estimated_cost, duration).
2. Call set_payment_terms(income_terms=..., retainage_rate=-0.10) with attacker-controlled rate (no bounds).
3. generate_billing_schedule writes inflated monthly IncomeItem.amount and a canceling negative INC-RET at end.
4. generate_forecast / calculate_financing_cost report a much lower financing_required; lenders/PMs act on the forged peak cash position.
findings.remediation: Clamp retainage_rate to [0, 1] (or project-legal max). Validate IncomeItem.amount >= 0 before forecast. Separately assert sum(income) ≈ contract_value within tolerance and flag interim/lifetime mismatch.
